subject: Re: FinTrust security review follow-up (data retention / logging)
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora.patel@fintrust.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, Jan 18, 2025 at 4:12 PM
Subject: FinTrust security review follow-up (data retention / logging)

Hi Nora,

Following up on today’s security review. Attached is our data retention FAQ.

Quick confirmation needed: when you say “no storage,” do you mean (a) disable storing prompt/response content in any logs/traces, while still keeping metadata (timestamps, status codes), or (b) zero retention of both content and metadata?

Thanks,
Kimberly
—
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference


From: Nora Patel <nora.patel@fintrust.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jan 20, 2025 at 8:41 AM
Subject: Re: FinTrust security review follow-up (data retention / logging)

Hi Kimberly,

We need zero retention of prompt/response *content*. That includes application logs, debug logs, tracing payloads, and any replay tooling. We can allow minimal operational metadata (request id, timestamps, status, latency) as long as it does not contain customer data.

To be explicit: Redwood should not store inputs or outputs at rest at any time. “Ephemeral processing only.”

Best,
Nora


From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora.patel@fintrust.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jan 20, 2025 at 10:02 AM
Subject: Re: FinTrust security review follow-up (data retention / logging)

Thanks Nora — understood. For Hosted API we do retain limited request/response samples for short periods by default for debugging/abuse detection, but we can support a “no content logging” configuration for enterprise accounts, and we can ensure traces exclude bodies.

Aisha will confirm the exact systems impacted (API gateway logs, tracing, support tooling) and the controls we can apply.


From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora.patel@fintrust.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 21, 2025 at 9:03 AM
Subject: Re: FinTrust security review follow-up (data retention / logging)

Hi Nora,

Confirming we can implement: (1) disable prompt/response content capture in request logs, (2) enforce tracing redaction for request/response bodies, and (3) restrict access to any support tooling so it cannot display content for your org.

We’ll still retain operational metadata (request id, timestamps, status, latency, model id) for reliability and billing.

If you want, we can add a short clause in the security addendum describing “zero retention of content.”

Regards,
Aisha
